title: Orbit standup + townline manifest v0-1
body:
Purpose:
Short working doc for the 2-week orbit cadence leading into the company townline and exec sync. Surface candidate company-level OKRs, run-of-show for the micro-all-hands, concrete exec asks, and a small contingency/risk canvas. This is rough — notes to self and collaborators throughout.

Audience:
Leadership, product & eng leads, GTM leads, comms owner.

Context / constraints (quick):
- Q1 budget pressure: need to demonstrate cost per inference improvements before mid-quarter exec review.
- Dedicated sales pipeline: 3 leads in late-stage that require SLA/throughput commitments.
- Private deployment compliance work (EU banking pilot) is blocking a go/no-go for one customer.

Draft company-level objectives (candidate OKRs) — feedback requested: (metrics are intentionally approximate)
1) Objective: Make inference predictable & 1st-class for production customers
   - KR1: Reduce median hosted API generation latency (p50) by 20% on the curated benchmark suite (target p50 <= 65ms).
   - KR2: Reduce unit compute cost for common small chat workloads by 15% (model+infra combo).
   - KR3: Ship canary rollout and automatic fallback policy in Console (GA for customers) by end of quarter.

2) Objective: Grow Dedicated revenue and adoption
   - KR1: Convert 3 POCs to committed Dedicated contracts (>= $120k ARR each).
   - KR2: Improve Dedicated onboarding time: average time-to-first-inference <= 14 days.

3) Objective: Harden Private for regulated pilots
   - KR1: Finish SOC-like audit checklist and KMS/HSM integration for the EU pilot (complete by 2025-02-28).
   - KR2: Zero unresolved critical compliance gaps for the pilot customer.

All-hands (micro) run-of-show (30–40 minutes) — proposed
- 0:00-0:03  Welcome + mood setting — CEO (Ava) — top-line three signals (thesis + one concrete ask)
- 0:03-0:10  State of the product — Head of Product (Priya) — 3 wins, 2 problems, 1 ask for teams
- 0:10-0:18  Ops & performance snapshot — Eng Ops (Marcus) — latency/cost charts, immediate mitigations
- 0:18-0:25  Customer snapshot — CS (Elena) — Dedicated pipeline 1-2 highlights, private pilot status
- 0:25-0:30  Exec asks + decisions needed — CFO & GTM (Jamal) — commitment ask + timeline
- 0:30-0:35  Q&A (pre-submitted prioritized) — moderated by comms
- 0:35-0:40  Close & immediate next steps (hyperspecific asks per team)

Exec asks (decision owners and deadlines)
- Approve $300k short-term Dedicated capacity reservation (finance sign-off) to cover Q1 POCs (owner: Jamal) — decision needed by 2025-01-20.
- Greenlight for a temporary aggressive batching/quantization experiment on hosted API that may slightly change tail quality in exchange for 12–15% cost savings (owner: Priya + Research) — decision by 2025-01-17.
- Priority reallocation: move 2 FTEs from greenfield infra work to compliance & private pilot until 2025-02-28 (owner: Eng SVP) — decision by 2025-01-22.

Communications plan (internal + customers)
- Internal: short follow-up note within 24h of all-hands summarizing decisions, point people, and any affected SLAs.
- Customers: targeted note to Dedicated POCs and the EU pilot with expected timeline and contact (CS lead).
- Public blog/demo: hold until we stabilize the canary fallback; target March once regression monitoring is mature.

Risks & mitigations (short)
- Risk: Model rollout causes quality regression for top customers.
  Mitigation: Canary routing + automatic fallback to last-good variant (test window 48h), retro active evals.
- Risk: Budget denial for Dedicated capacity impacts sales momentum.
  Mitigation: Offer a time-limited discount for early committed contracts and prioritize high-conversion POCs.
- Risk: Compliance blocker delays EU pilot.
  Mitigation: Escalate to Eng SVP + engage external assessor (blocker triage by 2025-01-21).

Unresolved questions (for discussion in the exec sync)
- Is the organization comfortable with a short-term quality vs cost experiment that could affect a subset of hosted customers for up to 2 weeks?
- Which metrics are definitive for 'cost per inference' given our mix of quantized model variants and caching? (Finance + Eng Ops to propose canonical metric)
- Do we accept the proposed Dedicated reservation size or prefer a phased commit?

Immediate action items (owner — due)
- Priya: finalize canary fallback implementation spec & rollout plan (draft by 2025-01-15).
- Marcus: prepare two latency/cost slides and a 24h mitigation checklist (2025-01-13).
- Jamal: prepare financial memo (impact + alternative options) for reserved capacity ask (2025-01-16).
- Elena: draft customer comms for Dedicated POCs and EU pilot (2025-01-14).

Notes to self / collaborators:
- Keep this doc short; spin a separate longer playbook if we get approval on the Dedicated ask.
- Collect pre-submitted questions in Slack #all-company by EOD 2025-01-13 — will triage to top 8.
- We should link the canary health dashboard directly in the follow-up note (Marcus to provide link).

References / quick links:
- Confluence: Orbit Planning Home (linked above)
- JIRA: OPS board JIRA-OPS-894 (roadmap tickets)
- GitHub: roadmap PR for executive memo (linked above)

End of working draft. Please add edits inline and mark anything that must be live in the all-hands follow-up.
